# verifiably

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
The ecosystem-level documentation for verifiably: what it is for, how its five repositories fit together, and where each one's own guide lives. For newcomers, collaborators, and agents who need the big picture before any repository's detail.
<!-- ops:identity end -->

verifiably aims to improve our understanding of the world by building it up from
small, reproducible data analyses, letting the data lead and keeping unverified
claims out. **Start with the [overview](overview.md).**

## Setup

Nothing to install. `just check` verifies every link, including links into the
sibling repositories when they are checked out beside this one.

## Layout

- `overview.md` — the ecosystem overview.
- `family.toml` — the verifiably family: its summary, members and README contract,
  rendered into every member's guides by ops-docs.
- `templates/README.md` — the README a member starts from.
- `tools/` — the link checker, and tooling vendored from ops.
- `tasks/` — task records, managed with the `tasks` CLI.

## Repositories

| Repository | Layer | Its own documentation |
|---|---|---|
| `atoms` | Crash-safe filesystem effects | [README](https://github.com/verifiably/atoms/blob/main/README.md) |
| `nodes` | Generic record and relation storage | [README](https://github.com/verifiably/nodes/blob/main/README.md) |
| `beliefs` | The epistemic kernel | [contributor guide](https://github.com/verifiably/beliefs/blob/main/docs/guide/README.md) |
| `science` | The daily surface: commands for people and agents | [README](https://github.com/verifiably/science/blob/main/README.md) |
| `autonomy` | Running the daily surface unattended | [README](https://github.com/verifiably/autonomy/blob/main/README.md) |

The layer column is each member's label in `family.toml`; change the two together.

## What lives here, and what does not

This repository holds what is true of the ecosystem as a whole: its goal, the
overview, and this map. Each repository keeps its own technical guide beside its
designs, where a design change and its guide update land in the same commit.
